query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (message_id)
                                kind,
                                key,
                                folder_id,
                                message_id,
                                sequence,
                                received_at,
                                fingerprint,
                                document,
                                body
                            FROM
                                imap_state_entries
                            WHERE
                                link_id = $1
                                AND kind = 'location'
                                AND folder_id = $2
                                AND message_id > $3
                            ORDER BY
                                message_id,
                                key
                            LIMIT 501
